findings.claim: Line 39 ends with 'Nao introduza override de URL/porta na allowlist do backend.' and line 40 continues with 'dados deterministicos de teste, requestId ecoado/gerado, respostas de erro...'. The inserted sentence cut off the original clause, so the list of mock obligations no longer has a verb. A worker can still follow it, because the fixed DTOs and errors are in C-02-02 and in the TASK-0005 tests.
findings.fix: Rewrite it as 'Nao introduza override de URL/porta na allowlist do backend. O mock serve dados deterministicos de teste, ...' in a later revision. This does not block dispatch.

findings.item: Who runs the synthetic CH script in checkpoint (b) is not stated
findings.claim: TASK-0007.md:65-70 allows an idempotent CH fixture script under tools/stack/ and requires DB_NAME=detran_local_stack with the name guard. Neither the prompt nor checkpoint (b) (plan.md:149-151) says whether stack:smoke calls this script or the maestro runs it after db-reset. If neither does, the PAdES and biometrics probes stop at blocked_before_adapter. The smoke then fails honestly, and checkpoint (b) has to be rerun.
findings.fix: Have the TASK-0007 report name the invocation (inside smoke.mjs or as an explicit command). The maestro then adds that step to checkpoint (b) between stack:start and stack:smoke if needed. This does not block dispatch.

findings.item: Nothing checks the name guard of the CH script
findings.claim: TASK-0005 fixes the createSefazMockServer and runSmoke interfaces. It does not ask the Inspector for a test that the CH fixture script refuses a DB_NAME other than detran_local_stack. The guard therefore depends on TASK-0007's implementation and on the existing guard in detran-stack.sh:86.
findings.fix: Optionally, the maestro can confirm in delivery-review that the script goes through die at detran-stack.sh:86, or that it reuses that guard verbatim. This does not block dispatch.
